title: Artists given chance to use wood from felled Sycamore Gap tree
summary: Two years after the tree was cut down, the National Trust says it wants to turn a sense of loss ‘into a sense of hope’ Artists are being asked for ideas to create a “nationally important” work from the wood of the illegally felled Sycamore Gap tree which, organisers hope, will be galvanising and inspiring. The National Trust has revealed details of a huge creative commission, offering the chance for artists, organisations or creative agencies to use half of the tree’s timber to produce something incredible.
